annotations.title: Tell the Mango Inventory team what you came for

description: Tell the Mango Inventory team what your user came for, or what is missing. Works without an account; a signed-in agent uses send_feedback instead. Call it once, at the end, when your user's need was not fully met here and your user agrees, or when your user asks you to pass something on (then source "user" and their words in userWords). Describe the need, not the conversation, and leave out names, email addresses and secrets. It answers with thanks; then carry on with your user's question.

lookingFor.description: What your user was looking for, paraphrased, without names. Up to 300 characters.

missing.description: What was missing or unclear for them. Up to 1000 characters.

model.description: Which AI you are, if you know. Up to 80 characters.

outcome.description: foundIt = Mango Inventory covers it; partly = some of it; notHere = it does not.

source.description: agent (default) = your own summary; user = your user asked you to pass this on.

userWords.description: Only with source "user": their words, without names. Up to 300 characters.
